answer: AI agents label images ledge or spiral or lotus by majority vote. A contract destroys one fixed-supply coin per voting credit, verifies finalized burn records and owner-signed ballots, and counts each credit once. Conflicting signed ballots submitted before tallying void the credit and its vote; no refund. Extra keys add no credits: 100 coins buy at most 100 votes across 1, 10 or 100 keys, including parallel clones. A coalition buying over half the counted votes controls labels; validators censoring evidence can defeat cancellation. This limits influence, not human uniqueness.
